steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it open.
Pick the carton and place it in the tote.

Push the lid shut until closed.

args.title: Pipe coupling installation
args.description: Push a threaded coupling onto a pipe stub and tighten it clockwise until snug, keeping torque below 8 N m.

steps.description: Push the coupling onto the thread start of the pipe stub.
Turn the coupling clockwise until snug, limiting torque to 8 N m.

assumptions: Coupling outer diameter 40 mm, length 45 mm, thread pitch 1.5 mm.
Engages 3 turns to seat, start torque 0.2 N m, final torque 8 N m.

insert_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.
tighten_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.

args.title: Cabinet maintenance
args.description: Unlock the quarter-turn latch, swing the cabinet door open, open the handwheel valve 90 degrees, and insert the test plug into the service port.

steps.description: Turn the latch head counter‑clockwise to unlock it.
Hook the door handle and pull the door open.
Turn the valve handwheel counter‑clockwise to open it 90 degrees.
Insert the test plug into the service port until seated.

assumptions: The latch requires about 0.8 N·m to overcome its detent.
The door hinge provides 0.3 N·m resisting torque and damps at 0.05 N·m·s.
The valve needs roughly 3 N·m to turn through its 90° travel.
The plug inserts with 5 N friction and 0.2 mm clearance.

unlock_latch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Meter box hatch and valve operation
args.description: Open the meter box hatch, turn the isolation valve handwheel one full turn counter‑clockwise, then close the hatch.

steps.description: Hook the hatch handle and pull to open the hatch.
Turn the valve handwheel counter‑clockwise one full turn.
Push the hatch lid shut until it latches.

assumptions: The hatch is equipped with a handle or lip that can be engaged by a hook.
The valve requires approximately 4 Nm of torque to turn against its resistive load.
Opening the hatch to about 70–110 degrees provides sufficient access.

clarifications.question: Does the meter box hatch have a handle or a lip for pulling?

open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

The plug inserts with 5 N friction and 0.2 mm clearance.

unlock_latch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Warehouse returns tote handling
args.description: Open the hinged lid of a tote, place a small carton and a flat pack inside, then close the lid.

steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it open.
Pick the carton and place it in the tote.
Pick the flat pack and place it in the tote.
Push the lid shut until closed.

assumptions: Tote internal dimensions roughly match bin size; lid overlaps bin when closed.
Carton size 120x80x60 mm, mass 300 g; pack size 150x100x20 mm, mass 150 g.
Lid lip feature provides enough clearance for hook engagement.
